title: Rule health (yg aspects --health --json)
$comment: This schema describes exactly what this release of Yggdrasil writes: every mapping is closed and every enumeration lists only the values this release uses. Use it to check a producer. Do not use it to reject a document you read: under the family rule a later release may add a field or a value within /1, and a /1 reader ignores what it does not know (see family-contracts).

wildcardMarkers.description: Suppress markers that apply to every rule, never attributed to one.

telemetry.description: The telemetry window the catch / exposure / false-block counts come from, in plain words, or `null`.

nodes.description: Distinct components with a pair for this rule.

files.description: Distinct type-covered files with a pair; `null` while `coverage.type_level` is off.

refused.description: Pairs whose recorded refusal still holds for the current inputs.

unverified.description: Pairs with no valid verdict on record — never counted as clean.

suppresses.description: Live suppress markers naming this rule (wildcards are counted once, in `wildcardMarkers`).

age.description: Coarse age of the rule source (`3mo`, `1y`, `unknown`), or `null` for a rule with no source.

catch.description: Violations the rule caught (refused fills); `null` when it has no recorded exposure.

exposure.description: Times the reviewer judged it (approved + refused fills); `null` when never.

signal.description: The coarse reading of catch against exposure: `active` | `quiet` | `decorative?`, or `null` with no exposure.

reading.description: The plain-words sentence the text view prints under the table for this rule, or `null` when it prints none.

falseBlocks.description: Blocks a human later waived or overturned, out of the blocks on record; `null` when the rule has blocked nothing.
